newsitem.title: GERMANY: BMW shares lower despite profit outlook.
newsitem.headline: BMW shares lower despite profit outlook.

text.p: Shares in German carmaker BMW AG traded lower despite BMW chief executive Bernd Pischetrieder saying he expected a 10 percent increase in profit and four percent sales growth in 1996.
Traders said the profit outlook was below market expectations.
"That clearly wasn't enough for the market," said one Frankfurt trader.
Shares in BMW were down eight marks at 860 marks, a drop of nearly one percent compared to the overall market which was up 0.03 percent at 2,567.50 points.
Pischetsrieder also told Reuters in an interview in Bangkok that he expected full year results to be in line with six-month figures.
